method: Source-backed comparison of all 120 verbs, each existing grammatical spelling and both UK/US pronunciations. Oxford English headwords and Verb Forms are the main source. Cambridge face2face PDF cross-checks UK; Oxford American and Cambridge US entries resolve GOAT notation; British Council supplies showed US. Assisted extraction with explicit review of homographs, strong/weak forms and source discrepancies; not an institutional certification of this application.
